questions.question: Who has achieved the 100+ runs and 4+ wickets in a match double more times, Mieke van Voorst or Suné Luus?
questions.explanation: Mieke van Voorst: 1 times. Suné Luus: 2 times.

questions.question: Who won CSA Women's Cricketer of the Year in the 2016 season?
questions.explanation: Dané van Niekerk won it in 2016.

questions.question: At which ground did Terry-Lee Kleynhans record their career-best bowling figures (3-19, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at West End Cricket Club Ground, against Heat on 2007/10/20.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most Fours' in the 12/13 season (T20)?
questions.explanation: Kirstie Thomson holds it, with a total of 28.

questions.question: At which ground did Badgers record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Recreation Ground — largest win by runs of 146, against Kei on 2018/11/18.

questions.question: At Boland Park, Paarl, who holds the record for 'Most Catches' (List A)?
questions.explanation: Sunette Loubser holds it with 11, a joint record shared with Alicia Smith.
